services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: September fishing in Crystal River is when the Nature Coast starts shifting from summer heat toward the first hints of fall, and one fish deserves most of the spotlight: gag grouper. The shallow rocks, ledges, holes, springs, and hard bottom off Crystal River create one of Florida’s most exciting shallow water grouper fisheries, and September brings a short, important harvest window under current 2026 Gulf regulations. For anglers who have been waiting on Crystal River grouper fishing charters, September is not a casual “maybe we’ll try it” month. It is a plan-around-the-calendar month. services.name: Kayak Fishing
services.desc: For the last 10 years the world’s of kayaking and fishing have merged into a match made in heaven. The only question I have is what has taken so long? Many of the most beautiful areas in Florida and along the Nature Coast are only accessible by kayaks and canoes during certain times of the year. I for one enjoy the peace and tranquility of the outdoors and there is no more quite way to enjoy the outdoors than slowly kayaking through many of the uncharted mangrove forests scattered throughout our area. blurb: Florida Fishing Adventures offers fishing charters in the Crystal River and Homosassa areas, known as the Nature Coast of Florida. Guests fish in clear waters with habitats including islands, backcountry coves, and creeks for species like redfish, speckled trout, grouper, tarpon, and more. They also offer scalloping trips and all-inclusive fishing vacation packages.
